EBITDA $117-120m), so the reported quarter is largely pre-announced and the print turns on the Q4 implied ramp (adj. EBITDA ~$140-151m) and any 2027 framing; peer and partner-bank reads (SoFi, The Bancorp) lean mildly positive, the print-day +6.6% run-up and +10.65 put skew lean the other way, so findings net to about +0.1 and p_up sits at 51 on a 12% absolute move.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue ~$705m and adj. EBITDA $117-120m, company guide raised 2026-09-08 (https://www.chime.com/newsroom/chime-announces-agreement-to-acquire-stride-bank/); consensus revenue $705.2m and EPS $0.09 (whisper $0.15) per Earnings Whispers 2026-10-27 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/CHYM/21805), consistent with the guide. positioning_check: Short interest 25,180,963 shares, 7.58% of float, 5.8 days to cover, record date 2026-10-15, down 2.9% from 25,929,970 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CHYM/short-interest, FINRA publication 2026-10-26; Massive.com shows the same 25.18M / 5.8 DTC). findings.finding: Chime reset its own Q3 guide on 2026-09-08, about two-thirds into the quarter, to revenue ~$705m (from $680-690m) and adj. EBITDA $117-120m (from $105-110m); consensus $705.2m sits exactly on it. On the last print the company beat its own revenue guide midpoint by ~5% ($670m vs $633-643m guide), but a guide set with two months of the quarter in hand leaves room for only a ~1-2% beat (~$710-720m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-05): revenue $670m vs $633-643m guide, with a FY raise, stock +20.56%. Q1 2026 (2026-05-06): revenue $647m, FY raised, but stock -12.52% (next-quarter EBITDA guide $72-77m vs $119m Q1). Beats on this line have been bought or sold depending on the guide, not on the beat.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the guide is public and consensus tracks it. What is not priced is the size of the beat over a mid-quarter reset; if the market expected a Q2-sized 5% beat, the whisper EPS would sit far above $0.15 and the stock would not be 12.6% under its high.
findings.independence: Q2 guide-vs-actual from the company's Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795586/000179558626000035/ex991q126.htm) and Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795586/000179558626000046/ex991q226.htm). Same company, different documents.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide of $2.76-2.77bn revenue and $481-489m adj. EBITDA, less Q1 ($647m / $119m), Q2 ($670m / $102m) and the Q3 guide ($705m / $117-120m), implies Q4 revenue of $738-748m (~26% y/y, a deceleration from ~30% in Q3) and Q4 adj. EBITDA of ~$140-151m, a ~19-20% margin against 15-17% in Q2-Q3. The Q4 guide must hold a steep EBITDA ramp; the 10% workforce reduction and easing Prime cash-back rewards cost support it, but a Q4 EBITDA guide below the implied ramp is the setup that cost -12.5% after Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: FY revenue raised but next-quarter EBITDA guide implied margin compression, stock -12.52%. Q4 2025 print (2026-02-25): 2026 outlook above expectations, +13.55%. Q2 2026: third FY raise, +20.56%. The guide line has decided the sign on every print in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The implied Q4 is arithmetic on public numbers, so the level is known; what is not known is whether management guides Q4 inside it or raises again (it has raised the FY three times). Revenue deceleration to ~26% leaves room for a raise; the EBITDA ramp leaves room for a disappointment. The +10.65 put skew is consistent with the market pricing the EBITDA risk.
findings.independence: Q1 and Q2 actuals from the company's own 8-K exhibits (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795586/000179558626000035/ex991q126.htm, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795586/000179558626000046/ex991q226.htm); restructuring savings from the Aug 5 8-K (https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2026/08/294636-consumer-fintech-chime-to-slash-10-of-workforce-due-to-ai-driven-efficiencies/). Rewards cost easing in H2 from a call summary (https://www.stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/CHYM/2026/Q2), secondary. Shares the Sep 8 document with finding 1 but lands on a different line.

findings.finding: Chime agreed on 2026-09-08 to buy partner bank Stride Bank for $590m cash (~1.5x tangible book), immediately EPS-accretive with >$100m of net synergies (partner-bank fees and funding costs), closing H1 2027 subject to OCC/Fed approval; the call is the first chance to quantify synergy timing and any 2027 framing, while the company says it will keep assets under $10bn to preserve the Durbin exemption.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement itself moved the stock ~+10% after hours and ~+11% premarket on 2026-09-09 (https://www.americanbanker.com/payments/news/chime-to-buy-longtime-partner-stride-bank-for-590-million). No prior print has carried this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is priced (the +10% on announcement). Only incremental detail on synergy phasing or approval progress is new; if the market expected a detailed 2027 synergy bridge on this call the stock would not sit 12.6% under its September high.
findings.independence: American Banker (https://www.americanbanker.com/payments/news/chime-to-buy-longtime-partner-stride-bank-for-590-million) and the $10bn asset-cap remark via fintech.global (https://fintech.global/2026/09/09/chime-to-acquire-stride-bank-for-590m/).

findings.finding: SoFi's Q3 2026 release (late October, after Chime last spoke) showed a record 1.2m member adds to 17.1m (+35% y/y), deposits +$5.8bn q/q to $51.3bn, Financial Services revenue +25%, a raised FY guide and a 2027 outlook above estimates: the closest listed consumer-fintech peer saw no slowdown in Q3 member acquisition or deposit demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline record of Chime reacting to peer prints; Chime's member-add line drove the +20.56% Q2 reaction (record 1.7m net adds over 12 months).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is +8.8% over a month. SoFi skews to a higher-income member base than Chime, so the read-through to Chime's mass-market members is indirect and was not translated into Chime estimates (consensus still equals the Sep guide).
findings.independence: Proxy, not a Chime number. The Bancorp's Q3 card volume (finding 5) points the same way from a different document.

findings.finding: The Bancorp (TBBK), one of Chime's two partner banks, reported on 2026-10-29 Q3 gross dollar volume on prepaid, debit and credit cards of $54.3bn vs $44.0bn a year earlier (+23%), fintech-fee-driven EPS of $1.53, and average deposits $8.42bn, flat q/q; card volume growth in the low 20s is consistent with Chime's purchase-volume trend, flat deposits a mild caution.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline record; Chime's purchase-volume line was cited in the +20.56% Q2 reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Bancorp does not break out Chime, so no aggregator maps its GDV to Chime estimates; it is a counterparty that spoke after Chime last did. If the market had read it as a Chime beat signal, consensus revenue would have moved above the $705m guide.
findings.independence: Proxy (a partner bank's portfolio-wide volume, not Chime's). SoFi (finding 4) is a separate document pointing the same way.

findings.finding: Visa's fiscal Q4 2026 release (2026-10-27) showed payments volume +9% in constant dollars and management described October volume growth as relatively stable: no sign of a broad US consumer-spending slowdown into Chime's quarter-end and Q4 guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro, broadly known and priced; US debit growth specifically was not extractable. Filed small as macro-to-company transmission.
findings.independence: October stability comment via Benzinga summary (https://benzinga.com/z/48499513), secondary.

findings.finding: The stock ran +6.58% intraday on the print day itself (to $30.06 at 13:02 ET, from $28.20), +4.86% over 5 days and +8.13% over 20, into a +10.65 vol-point put skew; with short interest a moderate 7.58% of float (5.8 days to cover, falling), the run-up raises the bar for the guide without a squeeze cushion of size.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No run-up-conditioned history in the baseline; the two largest down reactions (-14.68%, -12.52%) came on guide disappointments.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself; it is filed so the judges see that the entry spot already includes a same-day rally with no identified cause (no news found for 2026-11-04).
findings.independence: Short interest from MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/CHYM/short-interest); skew from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Insiders have sold about $1.2bn across 112 filings over 12 months with no open-market purchases; October sales were small 10b5-1 trades by co-founder Ryan King (50,000 shares at ~$29.40 on 2026-10-09; 11,318 at $31.03 on 2026-10-20 under a plan adopted 2025-08-28), CEO Britt sold under a plan in late August/early September.
findings.why_not_priced: Pre-scheduled plan sales carry little information and are public; filed for completeness as a supply overhang.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP results carry $16-20m of net cash restructuring charges from the ~10% workforce cut (partly offset by a $9-12m SBC reversal, net income hit $6-9m, roughly $0.02 a share), excluded from adj. EBITDA; a GAAP EPS headline against the $0.09 consensus could read light if estimates do not include it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print carried a restructuring charge.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed in the Aug 5 8-K and known; the only unpriced element is headline mechanics if some EPS estimates exclude it. The savings path to the Q4 margin is in finding 2.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview cites the same charge (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/CHYM/21805).

findings.finding: Credit is the watch line in the quarter: MyPay limits were raised to $1,000 with management expecting loss rates to tick up modestly (Q2 MyPay loss rate 0.9% on $4.5bn originations), and Instant Loans (originations +70% q/q to $300m in Q2) are guided to exit Q3 above a $100m revenue run rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No credit miss in the baseline; Compass Point initiated at Neutral citing credit risk (https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/chime-initiated-with-a-neutral-at-compass-point-on-credit-risk-thefly), undated in results.
findings.why_not_priced: Management pre-flagged a modest uptick, so a modest rise is priced; only a larger-than-modest move in MyPay losses would be new. No primary data on Q3 losses was found.
findings.independence: Q2 MyPay figures from the company's Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795586/000179558626000046/ex991q226.htm).

findings.finding: The CFO seat is still interim (Mark Troughton, President and interim CFO since 2026-08-07 after Matt Newcomb left); a permanent appointment or its absence may be addressed on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CFO departure was announced with the Q2 print, which rose 20.56%.
findings.why_not_priced: Known; no new search news found. Sized at zero.

outside_window.finding: Stride Bank acquisition closing and OCC/Fed approval expected H1 2027; synergies (>$100m net) accrue after close.

Durbin / Regulation II litigation (Corner Post vacatur stayed pending appeal; Fed 2023 proposal to cut the cap to 14.4c) does not touch Chime directly while it and its partner banks stay under $10bn in assets; no ruling dated in the window.

baseline_tension: Peer and partner-bank reads lean mildly positive and Chime has beaten and raised every print, but the +10.65 put skew and a +6.6% print-day run-up lean against, and the guide-heavy reaction history (two of five prints down double digits on guidance) keeps p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (inside the guide): Q3 revenue/EBITDA beat over a company-set mid-quarter guide cut from +0.5 to +0.3.

Lesson 7 (skew): the negative Q4-ramp guidance finding (-0.8 to -0.6) and the run-up/positioning finding (-0.4 to -0.3) agree with the downside-paid skew, so are partly priced; short interest checked (7.58%, not crowded).
Lesson 2 (one-offs): restructuring charge cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
Lesson 8 / core 3b: abs_move_pct raised from 11.5 to 12.0 (implied 10.13, own median 13.55, hunters run small).
Lesson 5 (proxies): SoFi, Bancorp and Visa reads left small and labelled as proxies; unchanged.
